summary: -i is parsed into iterations and the timed loop invokes spmvCpu for each iteration. Each call's OpenMP worker partitions the complete row range among threads; per row it follows the CSR start/end delimiters, loads columns, matrix values, and gathered vector entries, accumulates products, and stores the row result.

source_evidence.claim: The -i argument sets iterations, and the timed outer loop calls spmvCpu once per iteration.

spmvCpu chooses a thread count from workload size, workshares i in [0,dim), traverses each row's [rowDelimiters[i],rowDelimiters[i+1]) nonzero interval, accumulates val[j]*vec[cols[j]], and stores out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed native host loop invokes the outlined OpenMP SpMV worker, increments the iteration counter, compares against the configured count, and branches back until complete.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r4 persistent OpenMP team, per-iteration orphaned worksharing with barrier, complete rows/nonzeros, emitted outer loop and worker backedges. Checked r5 adjacent nonzero-balanced lower_bound row partitions, full CSR traversal, host repetition backedge and compiled row/nonzero loops/stores. No missing work identified.
primary_quality_check.timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not an exact duration: 22:07:09Z is the known launch lower bound and 22:11:13Z is an actual clock observation bounding completion. The earlier 22:08:42Z and 22:09:05Z values were actual clock observations, but neither marked the review-start or completion event.
